title: AOK knowledge card
description: Knowledge card distilled by the curator (feature ⑤, plan §3⑤), one YAML file per card. Lifecycle: candidate -> active (verified) -> stale (no reconfirmation for 60 days) or retired (contradicted). Promotion: a 확인-grade procedure card reconfirmed twice may be proposed as a SKILL.md change PR; 추론 cards are never promoted. Claims are declarative, never imperative (S5). PUBLIC REPO GUARD: cards derived from real session transcripts carry session ids and must live in the private ledger or a private repo, not in this public repository.

type.description: Card type. Only `procedure` cards are candidates for skill promotion.

claim.description: The lesson as a declarative statement (no imperative sentences, S5).

evidence.description: Transcript pointers backing the card (KPI: 100% of cards have pointers). A verifier judges the card from these pointers via get_event.

first_seen.description: Date (YYYY-MM-DD, optionally a full RFC 3339 time) the card was first distilled.

last_confirmed.description: Date of the last reconfirmation; drives the 60-day stale rule. Null if never reconfirmed.

hits.description: Number of times the card has been reconfirmed (2 on a 확인 procedure card = skill promotion candidate).

domain.description: Optional domain label used for the per-domain cap on active cards (§3⑤ promotion rule).
